checkpointed-execution

Success codes
can lie.

An agent skill that verifies each step's real effect, then stops for your go.

$ npx skills add
  pabasara-mahindapala/checkpointed-execution
Without the skill
$ ./bin/usersvc create alice
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
✗ "I ran step 1 and created user alice."
With the skill
$ ./bin/usersvc list → []
✓ "create prints 201 Created, then exits
  without writing anything."
⏸ Checkpoint 0/3 · standard
